Miss North Carolina USA Dethroned Over Alleged Racist Posts

Miss North Carolina USA, who was preparing to compete in the 75th Miss USA pageant, has been dethroned. The decision followed the resurfacing of alleged racist posts. The specific details of the posts and the exact timing of their resurfacing were not provided in the coverage.
